# Grass Valley Generators

Site: https://grassvalleygenerators.com/
This site is a lead service. It connects homeowners in western Nevada County, California, with a licensed contractor for whole-house standby generator installation, service, and a free in-home estimate. The site operator is not the installer. No contractor is named on the site yet.

## Towns and pages
- Grass Valley (homepage): https://grassvalleygenerators.com/
- Nevada City: https://grassvalleygenerators.com/nevada-city/
- Penn Valley: https://grassvalleygenerators.com/penn-valley/
- Lake Wildwood: https://grassvalleygenerators.com/lake-wildwood/
- Alta Sierra: https://grassvalleygenerators.com/alta-sierra/
- Generator service and maintenance: https://grassvalleygenerators.com/generator-service/

## Key sourced facts
- Average installed cost: $13,000 to $16,000, as published by the leading local Generac dealer (November 2026). Individual quotes vary by generator size, fuel run, electrical panel condition, and placement.
- Install wait: 8 to 10 weeks from prepayment, as published by that same dealer (November 2026). This site does not promise a shorter wait.
- Nevada County is in PG&E Public Safety Power Shutoff (PSPS) territory. About 2,137 customers were in the October 2026 shutoff scope, and outages peaked at 5,019 customers out on November 18, 2026. 30.4% of Nevada County is age 65 or older. These figures describe the county, not a single town outage.
- Populations (2020 census): Grass Valley 14,016; Nevada City 3,152. No population figures are published here for Penn Valley, Lake Wildwood, or Alta Sierra.
- Most installs in this county run on propane, because much of the county has no natural gas service.
- Planning sizes (loads decide the final size, confirmed at an in-home estimate): essentials only about 10–14 kW; most of a typical home about 18–22 kW; whole house with AC and a well pump about 22–26 kW.
- Yearly maintenance is required: oil, filters, plugs, a battery check, and a test run under load. Plan pricing is set by the servicing installer and is not listed on this site.
- Brands commonly installed and serviced in this market: Generac, Kohler, and Cummins.

## How to request an estimate
Use the form on the homepage: https://grassvalleygenerators.com/#book
Submitted details are shared with the licensed installer who handles the request.
